mechanism: Chlorthalidone may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia, while terbinafine is hepatically metabolized and may have additive effects on electrolyte balance; terbinafine is also a CYP2D6 inhibitor which could affect chlorthalidone metabolism to a minor degree.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and sodium) regularly during concurrent use; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops.
